segments.name: Stimulation Services
segments.description: Owns and operates mobile hydraulic fracturing fleets, providing stimulation services to E&P companies across major U.S. basins.
segments.evidence: Our Stimulation Services segment, which primarily relates to ProFrac LLC, owns and operates a fleet of mobile hydraulic fracturing units and other auxiliary equipment that generates revenue by providing stimulation services to our customers.

segments.name: Proppant Production
segments.description: Produces and sells frac sand and proppant to oilfield service providers and E&P companies from its own mines.
segments.evidence: Proppant Production. We generate revenue through the sale of frac sand to oilfield service providers and E&P companies.

segments.name: Manufacturing
segments.description: Machines, assembles and factory tests oilfield equipment such as pumps, valves and manifold systems, largely for the company's own fleets.
segments.evidence: Our Manufacturing segment sells products such as high horsepower pumps, valves, piping, swivels, large-bore manifold systems, and fluid ends.

segments.name: Flotek
segments.description: Supplies chemistry products and equipment along with field, installation and maintenance services to oilfield customers, including its own segment.
segments.evidence: Flotek. We generate revenue through sales of chemical products and equipment as well as various services associated with products sold, which includes field services, installation, maintenance, and other functions.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Holds other business activities, including Livewire, serving the company's own operations and third parties.
segments.evidence: Other revenues in 2025 increased $14.2 million from 2024.

revenueModel.text: E&P companies and oilfield service providers pay for stimulation services, frac sand, manufactured equipment and chemistry products and services.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue through the sale of frac sand to oilfield service providers and E&P companies.
